terminals.name: repo
terminals.command: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; export ZIG="$HOME/.local/bin/zig"; export CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID="${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-f45021db74a97feaafae2e3e131d4d82}"; [ -f "$HOME/.cargo/env" ] && . "$HOME/.cargo/env"; rustc --version; zig version; wrangler --version || true; echo; echo "D1: cd telemetry && wrangler d1 execute agent-hop-telemetry --remote --json --command \"SELECT COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS devices FROM events;\""; exec bash'
terminals.description: Shared repo shell with Rust, Zig, and wrangler. Use this from the phone to build, test, and query telemetry.
